reports.name: USDA Grain Export Inspections (delayed by Columbus Day)
USDA Crop Progress (delayed by Columbus Day)

outlook: Grain futures are mostly steady to slightly higher in Monday's overnight trade after Friday's USDA reports, which raised the U.S. corn yield to 181.2 bu/acre and 2026-27 corn ending stocks to 1.849 billion bushels, well above trade expectations. December corn settled 20½ cents lower Friday at $4.79¾ and is up about 1¾ cents overnight, while November soybeans are down about 4¾ cents after USDA's record yield forecast, with large speculators holding a net long near a one-year high. Wheat is little changed after President Trump announced a Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire in the Black Sea, though reports say attacks have continued. Monday is Columbus Day, so USDA's export inspections and Crop Progress reports move to Tuesday; Minneapolis cash bids shown are from Friday's final USDA report.
